I don’t know how much I would pay for KG to gas me up like this but it would be a LOT. These refs must have all shed a tear of joy hearing this


MY NAME IS MY NAME 🇺🇸🪮 (@ctreid89)

Kevin Garnett on how NBA refs used to officiate… you can hear the difference.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/ctreid89/status/2047694677139247489#m
At some point, the media has to get a little bit less self obsessed. Everything can’t be a media narrative when media is dying, you know? There’s a world out there, etc.

If an alien came down to earth and you explained football and politics to them and then showed them this site, they would assume Diana Russini was the quarterback of the Dallas Cowboys and Hasan Piker was president of the United States.
God please let this ass kicking ethical spurs team beat the demons from OKC.
Can the rockets self relegate down to the g league their players need to learn how to play basketball
Rockets could really use Jalen green

How was Reed Sheppard the third pick I will never understand. do people not have eyes. He’s getting cooked by Marcus smart in crunch time of a playoff game I don’t care he hit a 3 while I was typing this
How did white grab that rebound.
Loved the excited talk and then ‘VUCEVIC DOESNT EVEN LOOK AT THE RIM’
Great to have this announcing team in the playoffs. Imagine being excited about basketball!
Don’t want to be the fun police here but the russini stuff has gone way too far and for way too long.

I watch it all the way through every time. ‘Our ass is in the jackpot’ is just a beautiful phrase and I will never forget it


Baseball King (@BasebaIlKing)

Greatest mic’d up moment in baseball history

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/BasebaIlKing/status/2046995951429030065#m

Alright, details aside… we should want owners to cheat the salary cap, right? Better than money goes to the players, creates more pressure for broke owners to get out, and places upward pressure on the cap?
Just as a hoops fan I would rather just watch LeBron try to take Kennard, Smart and Ayton to the second round than see Luka come back hobbled and complaining. More maestro thinking Bron the better

This is so bad for the NBA. Cheap owners should not own pro sports teams in this country. Should be all ballmers and Cohens. Guys who spend on players and stadiums and see it as it should be: a cool thing they spend money on.


Ramona Shelburne (@ramonashelburne)

Sources told ESPN that Splitter was given a raise from his assistant coaching salary and discussed a longer-term contract during the season. The salary presented to him to continue on as head coach was far below a standard NBA head coa
Blazers flirting w the ethical hoops jinx fouling up 3 w 10 seconds left….
Society would improve if we just made the cameras on phones incredibly shitty like they were in 2004 or so
Fuck it the hater in me is screaming ‘THIS IS RUDY GOBERT REDEMPTION TIME’
